candidates.change_summary: Delete the `proposalCount += 1;` statement so proposalCount is never incremented by newGrantProposal.
Replace the increment `proposalCount += 1;` with `proposalCount += 2;` so each call raises proposalCount by two.
Replace the increment `proposalCount += 1;` with `proposalCount -= 1;` so each call decrements proposalCount.
Delete the assignment `VADER = _vader;` so VADER remains address(0) after init.
Replace `VADER = _vader;` with `VADER = _usdv;` so VADER is set to the USDV address.
Replace `VADER = _vader;` with `VADER = _vault;` so VADER is set to the VAULT address.
Delete the assignment to USDV so it stays address(0).
Delete the statement `VAULT = _vault;` so VAULT remains address(0) after init.
Replace `VAULT = _vault;` with `VAULT = _usdv;` so VAULT is set to the USDV address.
Replace `VAULT = _vault;` with `VAULT = _vader;` so VAULT is set to the VADER address.
Replace `VAULT = _vault;` with `VAULT = address(0);` so VAULT stays zero.
Remove the assignment `coolOffPeriod = 1;` so coolOffPeriod stays at its default value of 0 after init.
Change the assignment to `coolOffPeriod = 0;` so coolOffPeriod becomes 0 instead of 1 after init.
Change the assignment to `coolOffPeriod = 2;` so coolOffPeriod becomes 2 instead of 1 after init.
